agy-NOV

The 100% Native Modular Super-Workbench for Google Antigravity 2.0.

One plugin. Thirteen toggleable superpowers built on a clean 4-layer zero-cycle systems architecture (verified via TypeScript AST & Layer 2 horizontal cross-module allowlist) with full macOS / Windows / Linux native cross-platform compatibility (3-OS × Node 20/22 CI + 3-OS real-process hook black-box testing), featuring v1.3.0 real-device UX & onboarding polish (first-screen 3-step mobile pairing wizard with a zero-dependency pure-frontend ISO/IEC 18004 offline QR Code SVG component QrCodeSvg covering Byte mode / ECC-L / Versions 1–10 up to 271 bytes / 8-mask optimization / 4-module white quiet zone & zero network calls, 3-way loopback / one-click 0.0.0.0 LAN IP / inline Tailscale & Cloudflare tunnel switcher, large 6-digit pairing PIN & 7 step-by-step IM channel guides incl. Custom Webhook; toggle-on per-module setupHint onboarding drawers in SettingsHub & automatic loopback-only Remote setup reminder banners in HubPanel; full 8-language natural-copy rewrite across 800 core keys × 8 locales covering all 25 UI components at 1,458.7 KB; and backward-compatible schemaVersion: 1 dual-star feed-snapshot.json summary.remote read-only telemetry bindMode/configuredChannels/enabledChannels/setupState with zero-IO OFF isolation & zero URL/PIN/secret exposure), cross-process exclusive file locking (withFileLockSync) & P0 production hardening (wx + 0600 lock files protecting guard/radar/verify across 8 concurrent hook processes with zero loss, fail-closed PreToolUse ask & strict GuardStore.loadPolicy validation, MCP server disconnect/module-isolation fixes, EPIPE/ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED & realpathSync.native across all binaries, Canvas 7.5 MiB auto-pruning, Remote HTTP 400/401 & exponential backoff, X-Ray pre-persistence redaction + 4 MiB head/tail sampling + full >200-turn billing, Studio 256 MiB read-only SQLite + slice-before-redaction CSV, MCP Apps bridge timeouts & CanvasPanel 0×0 protection), 5-layer production stability defenses, full Antigravity Desktop v2.36.0 & Antigravity 2.35+ / 2.36+ compatibility, immediate dual-star feed-snapshot.json refresh with SHA-256 semantic dirty checking, disabled-module hard gating & PostToolUse O(1) short-circuit, opt-in read-only scheduled Audit Sidecar (sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs, OFF by default) & 11th CLI command audit-once (+0 model tools), Layer 1 shared loopback-only ConversationService Connect API collaboration, Marketplace-ready 10-key plugin.json & 18-asset + 4-check doctor, Spec DAG → /run-workflow Python & /swarm plan.json native orchestration compiler, PreInvocation inbound secret hard gate & PostInvocation zero-token turn receipts, 4 zero-injection-tax agy-nov://context/* resources, Antigravity CLI 47-tool ceiling gate, live roots/list workspace tracking, 4+1 domain IA & 4-tier Settings Hub, Ops 3.0, Mem 3.0, One-Click Clean Fork, 6 official on-demand Skills (9.5 KB entry Skill) & 2 read-only specialist subagents, native MCP Apps file viewer, Remote 2.5, Turbo 3.0, Guard 2.5, 6 official Hooks, minified backend bundles & 11-command CLI. Zero ASAR, Zero CDP, strictly 47 canonical model tools with zero token tax when off.

All 12 Tier-1 modules run 100% locally with zero external network calls, zero ASAR edits, and zero CDP hooks. 4. **Zero-Port Dual-Star Feed & 1 Strictly Opt-In Remote Module (`Remote 2.5`):** Event-driven `/feed-snapshot.json` (`schemaVersion: 1`, `version: "1.3.0"`, `atomicWriteJson` with `0600` permissions, failed-`.tmp` cleanup, `< 64 KiB`, O(n) redacted, SHA-256 semantic dirty check ignoring `generatedAt`, refreshed immediately before `PreToolUse` `deny`/`force_ask`/`ask` decisions and after CLI `enable`/`disable`/`preset`/`locale` updates, with `createdAt`-ordered `latestSnapshotId`, real-deny `GUARD_BLOCKED` reasons, latest-timestamp `verify` summary unified with `remote/hook.ts`, `forceAskCount`, `permissionMode`, `snapshotCount`, plus non-sensitive read-only `summary.remote` setup telemetry `bindMode`/`configuredChannels`/`enabledChannels`/`setupState` with zero IO when `remote` is off and zero URL/PIN/secret exposure, zero mkdir/writes when `dataDir` is absent) enables zero-port read-only telemetry sharing with `agy-Sag`, while `remote` stays completely OFF by default — zero listening ports, zero background polling, zero disk writes, and zero outbound network requests until you explicitly enable it. --- ## What's New in v1.3.0 `v1.3.0` delivers **real-device product UX & onboarding polish, a 3-step mobile pairing wizard with zero-dependency offline QR codes, a full 8-language natural-copy rewrite, and backward-compatible dual-star Remote setup telemetry** — making first-time setup and daily control effortless while keeping **+0 model tool bloat** (all **47** canonical model tools strictly unchanged from `v0.4`→`v1.3.0`, verified by **111 suites / 312 tests** across the macOS / Windows / Linux 3-OS CI matrix including 4-layer AST zero-cycle checks, 8-language 800-key symmetry & placeholder parity tests, and `test/v130-ux-qr-onboarding.test.ts`; measured minified artifacts: `dist/server.cjs` **`1,627.6 KB`** / `~1.59 MiB`, `dist/hook.cjs` **`232.3 KB`**, `dist/cli.cjs` **`211.7 KB`**, `dist/ui/app.html` **`1,458.7 KB`** / `~1.42 MiB`, `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md` **`9.5 KB`**, `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs` **`6.2 KB`**, `sidecars/README.md` **`4.2 KB`**): ### 1. 3-Step Mobile Pairing Wizard & Zero-Dependency Offline QR Code SVG (`QrCodeSvg.tsx` + `RemotePanel.tsx`) - **Pure Client-Side ISO/IEC 18004 Offline QR Component:** Added `ui/src/components/QrCodeSvg.tsx` (expanding the UI to **25 components**) with Byte mode, ECC-L, Versions 1–10 (up to 271 UTF-8 bytes), GF(256) Reed-Solomon error correction, 8-mask penalty scoring, and a 4-module white quiet zone — zero external dependencies and zero network calls. - **First-Screen 3-Step Guided Pairing:** - **Step 1 — 3-Way Connection Switch:** Switch cleanly between Local Preview (`127.0.0.1`), Same Wi-Fi Mobile Direct Connect (one-click hot-switch to `0.0.0.0` with automatic LAN IP calculation), and Away-From-Desk Tunnel (inline Tailscale & Cloudflare detection with saved public URL). - **Step 2 — Scan & Pair:** Displays the crisp offline SVG QR code beside a large 6-digit pairing PIN for instant mobile login. - **Step 3 — 7 IM Channels Guided Setup:** Built-in step-by-step setup guides for Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Custom Webhook. ### 2. Toggle-On Module Onboarding & Hub Setup Reminders (`SettingsHub.tsx` + `HubPanel.tsx`) - **Instant Toggle-On Onboarding:** Enabling any module switch in **Settings Hub** automatically expands its inline onboarding drawer, showing a concise single-sentence `setupHint`, essential toggles, and direct launch actions. - **Actionable Hub & Settings Reminders:** Whenever the Remote gateway runs in loopback-only mode with zero enabled IM channels, **HubPanel** and the Remote settings drawer automatically surface a banner jumping straight into the 3-step pairing wizard. ### 3. Full 8-Language Natural-Copy UI Rewrite (**800 Core Keys × 8 Locales** · 100% Parity) - **Everyday Human Copy Across All 8 Locales:** Rewrote all 8 bundled UI locale dictionaries (`en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`, `es`, `fr`, `de`) plus Settings Hub inline dictionaries to replace stiff engineering jargon and robotic phrasing with clear, natural, restrained everyday copy across all **25 UI components**, while keeping every interpolation placeholder and legacy key backward-compatible. ### 4. Backward-Compatible Dual-Star Feed Remote Setup Telemetry (`src/core/feed.ts`) - **Non-Sensitive Setup Progress for Companion Clients:** Extended `/feed-snapshot.json` (preserving `schemaVersion: 1`, updating `version` to `"1.3.0"`) with 4 optional read-only fields inside `summary.remote` — `bindMode` (`'loopback' | 'lan' | 'public'`), `configuredChannels`, `enabledChannels`, and `setupState` (`'off' | 'needs_setup' | 'ready'`) — letting companion clients (`agy-Sag`) display setup progress while maintaining strict zero disk IO when `remote` is off and zero URL, PIN, or credential exposure (see [`docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md`](./docs/DUAL-STAR-CONTRACT.md)).
Built on the v1.2.3 Cross-Process Exclusive File Locking (withFileLockSync), P0 Stability Hardening & X-Ray/Studio Foundation - **Cross-Process Exclusive File Lock (`v1.2.3`):** Added cross-platform `${target}.lock` (`withFileLockSync` in `src/core/fs-safe.ts`, `wx` + `0600`, symlink refusal, `.reclaim` single-winner dead-PID/stale recovery, timeout fallback) protecting `guard` (snapshots/audit/policy), `radar` (session board), and `verify` (synchronous persistence without spanning `await`), verified across 8 concurrent `dist/hook.cjs` child processes with zero data loss. - **Protocol, Hook, Server & CLI Hardening (`v1.2.3`):** Fail-closed `PreToolUse` `ask` on truncated/timed-out malformed stdin while `guard` is enabled; disconnect-safe `sendToolListChanged`, synchronous non-UI `oninitialized` gating + sequence-guarded non-blocking `roots` sync & per-module fault isolation; `EPIPE`/`ERR_STREAM_DESTROYED` exit guards & `realpathSync.native` across all binaries; CLI space-separated option skipping; and unified HTTP connection draining across `ConversationService` and `Remote`. - **Core Module P0 Boundary Hardening (`v1.2.3`):** Strict `GuardStore.loadPolicy` root-object validation blocking `null`/`[]` fail-open bypasses; `CanvasStore.writeBoard` `7.5 MiB` auto-pruning preventing `> 8 MiB` self-lockout & `addAnnotation` finite-number checks; `RemoteGateway` HTTP `400` malformed URI handling, persistent `error`/`clientError` listeners & clamped finite timeouts; Mobile PWA storage sandbox fallbacks & EventSource `401` halt/backoff; `Worktree` `stdin` `EPIPE` absorption; safe timestamp parsing in `Radar`/`Spec`. - **X-Ray Privacy/Billing & Studio Large-DB Upgrades (`v1.2.3`):** Pre-persistence linear redaction & `` stripping across `X-Ray` and `Radar`; `X-Ray` negative/invalid token normalization & bounded `4 MiB` head/tail sampling preserving full `> 200`-turn billing; independent `256 MiB` read-only SQLite ceiling in `Studio` (with WAL `immutable` fallback guidance) + slice-before-redaction CSV keeping filter-oracle protection; MCP Apps bridge `connect`/`callTool` timeouts & `CanvasPanel` `0×0` protection.

latestReleaseNotes:
## Highlights / 核心更新

**agy-NOV v1.3.0** focuses on day-one usability, guided setup, and plain-language interface copy while preserving the 100% Zero ASAR / Zero CDP native architecture (13 toggleable modules, 5 presets, strictly **47 canonical model tools**).

### 1. 3-Step Mobile Remote Wizard & Zero-Dependency Offline QR Code / 手机远程 3 步向导与离线真二维码
- Added a pure TypeScript, zero-dependency, 100% offline ISO/IEC 18004 QR Code SVG component (`ui/src/components/QrCodeSvg.tsx`, Byte mode, ECC-L, Versions 1–10 up to 271 UTF-8 bytes, GF(256) Reed-Solomon, 8-mask penalty selection, 4-module white quiet zone, zero external network requests).
- Redesigned `RemotePanel` around a clear 3-step flow:
  1. **Choose how to connect:** 3-way selector for Local preview (`127.0.0.1`), Same Wi-Fi direct mobile pairing (1-click hot-switch to `0.0.0.0` with auto-detected LAN IP), or Remote tunnel access (inline read-only `Tailscale` / `Cloudflare Tunnel` command detector + public URL save).
  2. **Scan & pair:** Crisp white-backed offline QR code alongside a large 6-digit PIN, copy/open/refresh controls, and a direct 1-click LAN switch callout whenever still on `127.0.0.1`.
  3. **Bind chat alerts:** Step-by-step setup guides directly inside the Channels tab for all 7 channels (**Feishu, DingTalk, WeCom, Telegram, Slack, Discord, and Custom Webhook**).

### 2. Auto-Onboarding Drawers & Setup Reminders / 开启即引导与未配置提醒
- Enabling any module switch in `SettingsHub` now automatically expands its drawer with a plain-language `setupHint` and next action.
- Both `HubPanel` and the `SettingsHub` Remote drawer surface a one-click setup banner whenever Remote is enabled on `127.0.0.1` with zero active notification channels.

### 3. Plain-Language Copy Across All 8 Locales (800 Keys × 8 Locales) / 8 语种全界面去 AI 腔重写
- Rewrote all 8 UI locales (`en`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `ja`, `ko`, `es`, `fr`, `de`) and inline settings labels to replace internal engineering jargon and AI-style marketing phrases with concise, direct everyday product copy — expanding to **800 symmetric core keys × 8 locales** across **25 UI components**.

### 4. Backward-Compatible Dual-Star Snapshot Telemetry / 双星快照非敏感配置状态扩展
- Kept `feed-snapshot.json` at `schemaVersion: 1` while adding 4 optional read-only non-sensitive fields under `summary.remote`: `bindMode` (`loopback` | `lan` | `public`), `configuredChannels`, `enabledChannels`, and `setupState` (`off` | `needs_setup` | `ready`) — maintaining zero disk I/O when disabled and zero secret/PIN/URL exposure.

---

## Verification & Artifacts / 验收与产物体积
- **Automated Tests:** **111 suites / 312 tests** passing (`npm run typecheck`, `npm test`, `doctor`, `workbench --smoke`)
- **3-OS Real-Machine CI (6/6 Green):** [GitHub Actions Run #46166516925](https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/actions/runs/46166516925) (`macos-latest`, `ubuntu-latest`, `windows-latest` × Node 20 / 22)
- **Measured Artifacts:**
  - `dist/server.cjs`: `1,627.6 KB` (`~1.59 MiB`)
  - `dist/hook.cjs`: `232.3 KB`
  - `dist/cli.cjs`: `211.7 KB`
  - `dist/ui/app.html`: `1,458.7 KB` (`~1.42 MiB`, 800 keys × 8 locales × 25 components)
  - `skills/agy-nov/SKILL.md`: `9.5 KB` · `sidecars/audit-sidecar.mjs`: `6.2 KB`
- **All 8 README locales & contract docs synchronized.**

Full Changelog: https://github.com/tone-leh/agy-NOV/compare/v1.2.3...v1.3.0
